description: Seat a waiting guest now as a walk-in, turning the entry into a reservation. Only an entry whose date is null or today can be seated; another date fails with invalid_transition. Pass the same idempotencyKey when you retry after a timeout or an error. Without it a retry is a new write and may create a duplicate.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string for this write. Send the same one again to retry it. Omit it and the server makes a new one.

name: waitlist.seat
title: Seat a waitlist entry
